text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Overdraft Policy v3.0, Harbor charges a $29 fee per item paid through Courtesy Pay, up to a maximum of 3 items per business day (so up to $87 in per-item overdraft fees). No overdraft fee applies if the account is overdrawn by $25.00 or less at day's end. Separately, if you use Overdraft Transfer Protection, only one $5.00 transfer fee is charged per business day regardless of how many items it covers.","cited_chunk_ids":["overdraft_policy_v3::layout::B_structure::0004"],"reason":"The Overdraft Policy v3.0 Section 4 directly states the per-item fee and the daily cap of three items, plus the separate daily cap on the transfer protection fee."}
